newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on October 29.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on October 29.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on October 29, a central bank official said on Monday.
The volume of three-month T-bills was set at five million hryvnias, the head of the bank's market and exchange dapartment, Vitaly Migashko, told Reuters.
The central bank is not setting the issue volume of six-month, nine-month and 12-month T-bills in advance.

At the last auction of three-month discount T-bills on October 22, the bank sold five million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 30.65 percent. The average price was 92.90 hryvnias.

At the last auction of six-month discount T-bills on October 25, the bank sold 21.83 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 49.36 percent. The average price was 80.25 hryvnias.

At the last auction of nine-month discount T-bills on October 25, the bank sold 32.81 million hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 58.20 percent. The average price was 69.67 hryvnias.
At the last auction of 12-month discount T-bills on October 25, the bank sold 572,900 hryvnias worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 61.04 percent. The average price was 62.16 hryvnias.
